#### Markham to Lead the National Semiconductor Sector


Posted on January 25, 2023


Mayor of the City of Markham,[Frank Scarpitti](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mayor-frank-scarpitti/) , and ventureLAB's COO,[Matt Skynner,](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mattskynner/) spoke to City News about Canada becoming a leader in the world's semiconductor sector and ventureLAB's role in driving this forward.


" *Canada has a great opportunity to be a leader both from the development of these technologies as well as, on a long-term basis, a North American supply chain.* " - Matt Skynner, COO at ventureLAB
